0.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_000
0.description: Settled in, are ye? Good for you. I'd like nothin' more than to board the first boat back to Eorzea, but no use pinin' for liberation what ain't about to come.

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_001
1.description: This debt o' mine'll keep me shackled to this place for the foreseeable future, I reckon. Anyroad, ye got that protean crystal I've been waitin' for? Good.

2.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_002
2.description: Aye, this'll do...though I'll need more than just the one─an' I'll only be able to work with weapons or gear o' the sort as made for practitioners o' certain powerful arts...

3.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_003
3.description: But I'll work like a dog if I have to! For yer sake an' mine! An' then we can both bugger off this bloody rock an' go somewhere every livin' thing ain't tryin' to kill us!

4.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_000_004
4.description: You may now create and augment Eureka gear and arms. To begin, you will need to provide Gerolt with the requisite level 70 antiquated items and protean crystals.

5.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_010
5.description: So, what'll it be? Arms or armor?

6.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_Q1_000_000
6.description: What would you like to do?

12.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_A1_000_004
12.description: Learn about Eureka weapons and gear.

14.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_020
14.description: Love to oblige ye, but a horde o' protean crystals won't suffice if I'm to cobble together somethin' truly astoundin'.

15.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_030
15.description: An' besides, ye haven't even got a suitable arm for me to work with! Maybe set yer sights a little lower before shootin' for the stars, aye?

16.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_100_031
16.description: To proceed, you must first acquire <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> and <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E803020203> to augment.

17.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_000_031
17.description: To proceed, you must first acquire <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> to augment.

18.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_040
18.description: What exactly do I need, ye ask? Can't rightly say, but I'll know it when I see it. Somethin' bleedin' rare, I reckon. Come an' see me when ye think ye've found somethin' suitable.

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_100_041
19.description: To augment <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> and <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203>, you will need to procure something other than protean crystals. Speak with other players and share information to discover how to proceed!

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_000_041
20.description: To augment <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>, you will need to procure something other than protean crystals. Speak with other players and share information to discover how to proceed!

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_100_040
21.description: Don't tell me...ye've found it, haven't ye!? That special thing I've been waitin' for! Give it over─let me see!

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_110_040
22.description: ...Pazuzu's feathers? Aye, they'll do just fine...but I'll need more than what ye've got. Sorry to get yer hopes up─but at least ye know what yer lookin' for, eh?

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_050
23.description: Don't tell me...ye've found it, haven't ye!? That special thing I've been waitin' for. An' in sufficient quantities, no less! Give 'em over─the weapon too!

24.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_060
24.description: Muahahaha... MUAHAHAHAHAHA! Just you wait, friend! Yer in for a show!

25.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_070
25.description: It's done! I've harnessed the essence of Anemos an' created the very pinnacle o' what this bastard region's got to offer! I give ye...<hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> an' <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203>!

26.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_080
26.description: It's done! I've harnessed the essence of Anemos an' created the very pinnacle o' what this bastard region's got to offer! I give ye...<hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>!

27.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_090
27.description: An' with that, I've discharged a good chunk o' my debt to the harridan! Not nearly enough to get me off this bloody rock but hells, it's somethin'! Huzzah! Huzzah for incremental progress!

32.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_A4_000_001
32.description: Creating and augmenting Eureka gear and weapons.

36.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_100
36.description: Eh? What's there to ask? If ye want to stand a fightin' chance against the beasties o' this rock, ye'll want me to strengthen yer arms an' armor!

37.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_000_101
37.description: Gerolt can create Eureka gear and weapons if you provide him with the requisite level 70 antiquated items and protean crystals. He can also augment these creations further with additional protean crystals.

38.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_000_102
38.description: If you do not possess level 70 antiquated gear or weapons, you may purchase them from the Calamity salvagers located in Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, and Ul'dah.

39.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_110
39.description: Don't go puttin' the cart before the chocobo. If ye want somethin' that bleedin' powerful, ye'll need to provide somethin' bleedin' powerful. An' protean crystals won't be enough either...

40.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_000_111
40.description: To augment +2 Eureka weapons, you will need to procure something other than protean crystals. Speak with other players and share information to discover how to proceed!

41.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_GEROLT_000_120
41.description: I'll toss a few protean crystals yer way in exchange for any Anemos crystals ye don't need. How many? Well, that's for me to decide after I give 'em a good look. If that's not to yer likin', then piss off.

42.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1SPWEAPON_00450_SYSTEM_000_121
42.description: Gerolt will give you a random quantity of protean crystals in exchange for Anemos crystals.
